title: DSPy Base Modules
summary: This module defines the foundational building blocks for DSPy programs, including the base class for all modules, core parameter management, and an interface for sandbox serialization.

nodes.label: BaseModule
nodes.title: BaseModule
nodes.description: Provides fundamental functionalities for DSPy modules, including parameter management, sub-module discovery, deep copying, and state serialization/deserialization.

nodes.label: Module
nodes.title: DSPy Program Base Class
nodes.description: The base class for all DSPy programs, extending BaseModule with core program logic, callback handling, LM usage tracking, and methods for managing Predict modules.

nodes.label: SandboxSerializable
nodes.title: RLM Sandbox Interface
nodes.description: An abstract base class for types that can be injected into an RLM (Reinforcement Learning Module) sandbox, defining an interface for serialization and reconstruction.

nodes.label: Parameter
nodes.title: Optimizable Parameter
nodes.description: Represents an optimizable parameter within a DSPy module, managed by BaseModule for state and optimization.

nodes.label: Predict
nodes.title: Language Model Predictor
nodes.description: A core DSPy primitive that performs language model predictions based on a defined signature, managed by the Module class.

nodes.label: Parallel
nodes.title: Parallel Execution Utility
nodes.description: A utility for processing lists of examples in parallel, used by the Module class for batch execution of its forward method.

nodes.label: REPLVariable
nodes.title: REPL Sandbox Variable
nodes.description: Represents a variable within the REPL sandbox environment, often created from SandboxSerializable objects.

nodes.label: dspy.Signature
nodes.title: LM Input/Output Definition
nodes.description: Defines the input and output fields for language model interactions, capable of using SandboxSerializable types as annotations.

nodes.label: LM Client
nodes.title: Language Model Integration
nodes.description: External service or client responsible for interacting with various Language Models to perform text generation or other LM tasks.

nodes.label: Serialization Storage
nodes.title: Persistent Storage
nodes.description: File system or database used for persisting the state or entire program architecture of DSPy modules (e.g., JSON, PKL files).

groups.label: Core Primitives
groups.title: Fundamental Building Blocks
groups.description: Essential classes that provide the basic structure and capabilities for DSPy modules and sandbox integration.

groups.label: Surface API
groups.title: User-Facing Program Interface
groups.description: The primary class that users inherit from to define their DSPy programs, orchestrating various components.

groups.label: Generative Components
groups.title: Language Model Interaction
groups.description: Components responsible for interacting with language models to generate outputs based on defined instructions.

groups.label: Analytical Utilities
groups.title: Performance and Batch Processing
groups.description: Utilities that support efficient execution and analysis of DSPy programs, such as parallel processing.

groups.label: Data Structures
groups.title: Internal Data Representation
groups.description: Classes representing data elements and structures used within DSPy modules and for sandbox interactions.
